text:
Ava: Anyone else miss a page around 09:08? I never got the critical page.
OpsBot: alert: pager event id=PD12345 failed deliver to @Ava - gateway response=403 not_in_channel
Priya: I see the PD incident but page_count to oncall was 0, weird.
Sam: quick look at pagerbot logs -> 2026-05-01T09:08:14Z slack.postMessage -> 403 missing_scope (chat:write). Also seeing an IAM role rotation entry at 02:12 UTC that touched service-account used by integrations.
Ava: That rotation was scheduled? who executed it?
Marta: That was the least-priv rollout last night. We tightened service-account roles; looks like we inadvertently revoked chat:write for the pager integration in prod channels. My mistake.
Priya: Ok mitigation plan: re-add PagerBot to #incidents-prod and re-grant chat:write, then reissue webhook/token so retries aren't suppressed.
Sam: Commands to run:
```
# invite bot back into channel
curl -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.invite \
  -d token=$ADMIN_TOKEN \
  -d channel=CINCIDENTS_PROD \
  -d users=UPAGERBOT

# sanity manual page
scripts/manual-page.sh --incident PD12345 --target @Ava
```
Marta: Doing the invite now. Will also reapply the chat:write scope in the IAM console and re-roll the bot token.
OpsBot: action: /run scripts/manual-page.sh PD12345 -> 200 OK (delivered to @Ava)
Ava: I got the manual page just now :thumbsup: — looks good.
Priya: Customer side: metrics show a spike in error rates 09:05–09:12 UTC; engineering has a hotfix queued. Marking incident severity = sev2 until we confirm recovery.
Sam: Root cause summary: role rotation removed required outgoing scope for PagerBot causing outgoing slack pages to be rejected (403). Pager retry logic treats non-2xx as permanent in a couple of code paths, so pages were suppressed.
Marta: Immediate follow-ups I will do: 1) PR to rotation runbook to include a post-rotation verification step that runs a test page to a staging oncall channel, 2) add a CI check that verifies PagerBot can post to critical channels after role changes, 3) notify infra owners.
Priya: I'll update the incident ticket INC-2026-456 with timeline and customer impact. Sending interim status to status.redwood.ai.
Sam: Small log snippet for pastebin/forensics: 
```
2026-05-01T09:08:14.123Z pagerbot[proc-7] INFO postMessage -> 403 {"ok":false,"error":"missing_scope","needed":"chat:write"}
2026-05-01T09:08:14.124Z pagerbot[proc-7] WARN abandon retry (403 permanent)
```
Ava: Thanks team. Manual paging in place, engineering patch in progress. Monitoring for 30m and then reassess.
Marta: Apologies for the noise — will follow up with a retro and the PR link here.
Priya: Added temporary runbook note: `if pages=0 && slack 403 -> invite bot + reissue token + manual page`
Sam: Suggestion for long-term: add an automated periodic integration probe that posts a heartbeat page to a private channel and alerts on failures.
Ava: Agreed. For now we have oncall covered.
OpsBot: incident INC-2026-456 created and assigned to eng-oncall.
Marta: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-482 (will paste details after CI passes).
Ava: Closing the immediate communication loop. Will keep monitoring.
